name: List counter: number + badge
when: Each new item of a numbered list when the viewer should keep seeing where they are: the number rolls up big on the cut, then shrinks into a top-left badge with the total (11/48) while the item plays, and leaves before the next item.
anchor: The reels hit full speed on the cut to the item (`cut`, 0.12 s after the scene starts): start the scene 0.12 s before that cut. The number shrinks into the badge 0.5 s after the cut.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.number: the item's place in the list, 1 to 999
vars.total: how many items the list has, shown after the number on the badge (/48); a longer total widens the badge
vars.cut: seconds after the start: the cut to the item's first shot (at least 0.12; keep 0.12 and start the scene 0.12 s before the cut)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the badge leaves (validated 2.04 s after the cut, just before the next item; the scene ends 0.2 s later)

changed: The units reel lands in 0.38 s after the cut instead of 0.4 s (within 0.5 s of its first move). Any number from 1 to 999 and any total: the badge plate grows with a longer total.
